Stop restyle — copy these files, no plugin install.

1. Copy this folder to %USERPROFILE%\.grok\stop-restyle  (or ~/.grok/stop-restyle).
   Keep prompt.md next to scripts/.

2. Copy hooks.json to %USERPROFILE%\.grok\hooks\stop-restyle.json  (or ~/.grok/hooks/).

The Stop command runs `sh …/scripts/stop-restyle` first (POSIX, python3),
then `pwsh …/scripts/stop-restyle.ps1` if `sh` is missing.

The script finds prompt.md beside this folder if GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT is unset.
Child binary is GROK_REAL if set, else grok on PATH.

If PATH grok is a shim that injects --system-prompt-override or re-fires Stop,
set GROK_REAL to the unwrapped binary and keep the isolated child home.
